<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## AITER prerequisites

None. The prefix offsets are computed on the host in SGLang. This change does not call an AITER kernel.

## Motivation

With DCP, MHA prefill over a cached prefix all-gathers the prefix KV and then interleaves it with the new tokens' KV, one request at a time. `all_gather_kv_cache_for_mha_extend` computed the slice bounds with `torch.cumsum` on the GPU. Slicing a tensor at a GPU-scalar bound forces a blocking device-to-host copy, so each prefill step paid 4 syncs per request per MLA layer. The same lengths are already on the host in `forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu` and `forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu`.

## Modifications

- `all_gather_kv_cache_for_mha_extend` (`layers/dcp/comm.py`) computes the per-request offsets on the host with `itertools.accumulate` over `extend_prefix_lens_cpu` and `extend_seq_lens_cpu`.
- The device cumsum path is removed. Every `ForwardBatch` path that sets `extend_prefix_lens_cpu` also sets `extend_seq_lens_cpu` and pads both to the batch size, and the caller already depends on `extend_prefix_lens_cpu`.
- The unused `seq_lens`, `extend_prefix_lens`, and `extend_seq_lens` arguments are dropped. The two callers, `forward_mha.py` (CUDA) and `forward_mha_rocm.py`, now pass `extend_seq_lens_cpu`.

Outputs do not change: the offsets have the same values, now computed on the host. I checked the old and new interleaving on CPU against 500 random batches, including extend KV with trailing padded rows, and they match exactly.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 questions, same setup as the speed test below:

| Base | This PR |
|---:|---:|
| 0.941 | 0.948 |

On this setup, GSM8K varies by about 0.01 between runs of the same serving path, so this difference is noise.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Mean TTFT is 3.5% lower and median TTFT is 4.6% lower. TPOT and the prefix cache hit rate do not change.

| Metric | Base | This PR | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 5369 | 5179 | -3.5% |
| Median TTFT (ms) | 4881 | 4655 | -4.6% |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 24.23 | 24.25 | +0.1% |
| Output throughput (tok/s) | 354.5 | 360.4 | +1.6% |
| Prefix cache hit rate | 68.6% | 68.6% | |

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

- Hardware: MI355X x8.
- Model: Kimi-K3, Quark MXFP4 MoE with FP8 attention.
- Server: the cookbook's MI355X configuration. TP8, `--dcp-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a`, AITER prefill and decode attention, FP8 KV cache, radix cache on, `--chunked-prefill-size 8192`.
- Workload: `python -m sglang.benchmark.serving --dataset-name generated-shared-prefix`, with 32 groups x 8 prompts, a 16384-token shared prefix, a 1024-token question, 256 output tokens, and concurrency 16. The cache was warmed with a different seed and flushed before the measured run.
- Both sides set `SGLANG_AITER_FP8_PREFILL_ATTN=0`. On `main`, the FP8 prefill kernel `_mla_fp8_prefill_attn_ps` tries to allocate about 1.2 TiB for a cached prefix under DCP8 and runs out of memory. That bug is unrelated to this PR.
- The numbers were measured on the previous revision of this PR. That revision used the same host-offset slicing and still had the device fallback, which this run never reached.

</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). No new test. The MHA extend path is covered by `test/registered/dcp/test_dsv31_dcp8_gsm8k.py`.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not applicable, because there is no user-facing change.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@
   - cp_lse_ag_out_rs_mla: Triton (log2/exp2) correction / reduce-scatter
 """
 
+import itertools
 from typing import Optional
 
 import torch
@@ -204,21 +205,18 @@ def all_gather_kv_cache_for_mha_extend(
     token_to_kv_pool,
     attn_mqa,
     dcp_local_prefix_kv_indices,
-    seq_lens,
-    extend_prefix_lens,
     extend_prefix_lens_cpu: list[int],
-    extend_seq_lens,
+    extend_seq_lens_cpu: list[int],
     kv_a: torch.Tensor,
     k_pe: torch.Tensor,
 ):
     prefix_kv_a, prefix_k_pe = token_to_kv_pool.get_mla_kv_buffer(
         attn_mqa, dcp_local_prefix_kv_indices, dst_dtype=kv_a.dtype
     )
-    extend_prefix_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(extend_prefix_lens_cpu)
     gathered_kv_cache = all_gather_kv_cache_for_dcp(
         prefix_kv_a,
         prefix_k_pe,
-        extend_prefix_lens_cpu,
+        torch.tensor(extend_prefix_lens_cpu),
     )
     prefix_kv_a, prefix_k_pe = gathered_kv_cache.split(
         [kv_a.shape[-1], k_pe.shape[-1]], dim=-1
@@ -230,28 +228,18 @@ def all_gather_kv_cache_for_mha_extend(
         prefix_kv_a = prefix_kv_a.to(kv_a.dtype)
     if prefix_k_pe.dtype != k_pe.dtype:
         prefix_k_pe = prefix_k_pe.to(k_pe.dtype)
-    # re-organize kv with query orders
-    prefix_lens_cu = torch.zeros(
-        len(seq_lens) + 1,
-        dtype=torch.int32,
-        device=kv_a.device,
-    )
-    extend_lens_cu = torch.zeros_like(prefix_lens_cu)
-    prefix_lens_cu[1:] = torch.cumsum(extend_prefix_lens, dim=0)
-    extend_lens_cu[1:] = torch.cumsum(extend_seq_lens, dim=0)
-    kv_a_tuple = ()
-    k_pe_tuple = ()
-    for i in range(len(seq_lens)):
-        kv_a_tuple += (
-            prefix_kv_a[prefix_lens_cu[i] : prefix_lens_cu[i + 1]],
-            kv_a[extend_lens_cu[i] : extend_lens_cu[i + 1]],
-        )
-        k_pe_tuple += (
-            prefix_k_pe[prefix_lens_cu[i] : prefix_lens_cu[i + 1]],
-            k_pe[extend_lens_cu[i] : extend_lens_cu[i + 1]],
-        )
-    kv_a = torch.cat(kv_a_tuple, dim=0)
-    k_pe = torch.cat(k_pe_tuple, dim=0)
+    # Host lengths avoid a device sync per slice bound, and this runs once per MLA layer.
+    prefix_starts = [0, *itertools.accumulate(extend_prefix_lens_cpu)]
+    extend_starts = [0, *itertools.accumulate(extend_seq_lens_cpu)]
+    kv_a_parts = []
+    k_pe_parts = []
+    for i in range(len(extend_seq_lens_cpu)):
+        prefix = slice(prefix_starts[i], prefix_starts[i + 1])
+        extend = slice(extend_starts[i], extend_starts[i + 1])
+        kv_a_parts += [prefix_kv_a[prefix], kv_a[extend]]
+        k_pe_parts += [prefix_k_pe[prefix], k_pe[extend]]
+    kv_a = torch.cat(kv_a_parts, dim=0)
+    k_pe = torch.cat(k_pe_parts, dim=0)
     return kv_a.contiguous(), k_pe.contiguous()

@@ -270,10 +270,8 @@ def forward_normal_prepare(
                         get_token_to_kv_pool(),
                         self.attn_mha,
                         forward_batch.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_local_prefix_kv_indices,
-                        forward_batch.seq_lens,
-                        forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens,
                         forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu,
-                        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens,
+                        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu,
                         kv_a,
                         k_pe,
                     )

@@ -237,10 +237,8 @@ def forward_normal_rocm_prepare(
                         get_token_to_kv_pool(),
                         self.attn_mha,
                         forward_batch.attn_dcp_metadata.dcp_local_prefix_kv_indices,
-                        forward_batch.seq_lens,
-                        forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens,
                         forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu,
-                        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens,
+                        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu,
                         kv_a,
                         k_pe,
                     )
